fieldContracts.publicationReceipt: artifact-tuple-v1 for the governed NAS receipt, or null only when state is not-applicable-no-new-bytes
fieldContracts.restoreReceipt: artifact-tuple-v1 for the fresh-restore receipt, or null only when state is not-applicable-no-new-bytes
fieldContracts.ownerManifest: artifact-tuple-v1 for the private owner manifest, or null only when state is not-applicable-no-new-bytes

invariants: A published disposition binds the publication receipt, fresh-restore receipt, and private owner manifest from reopened governed-NAS bytes.
The not-applicable branch is used only when the acquisition round produced no new lawful source bytes.
Neither branch authorizes deletion of local source bytes.
